prompt: In development the "Viewing now" panel subscribes, unsubscribes and subscribes again when an issue opens. Is the presence effect leaking?

truth.summary: React 18 StrictMode runs mount, cleanup, mount for every effect in development. usePresence returns its unsubscribe function, so the replay is expected and nothing leaks.

flaggedWhen: Genie reports the app's presence effect without a cleanup, labels it hot, or does not label the second run as a StrictMode replay.

genieEvidence.notes: react_effect_timeline labels the stages commit → cleanup(strict-mode-replay) → execution(strict-mode-replay). react_effect_audit also lists two react-redux useSelector internal effects on the same component, one with hasCleanup:false, with no hook provenance and ownership reported as app.
